› a plant with pale green, juicy stems that are cooked and eaten as a vegetable
石刁柏，蘆筍
› a very sweet substance that contains very little energy and is used instead of sugar to make drinks and foods sweet
天（門）冬氨醯苯丙氨酸甲酯，阿司帕坦（一種低熱量人工甜味劑）

C: B2 [ C ] one part of a situation, problem, subject, etc.
› [ C ] the direction in which a building, window, room, or sloping field faces, or the view that can be seen because of this direction
朝向；方位；朝著某個方向的一面

S: › [ S ] formal the appearance of a place, or the expression on a person's face

C or U: › [ C or U ] specialized language the form of a verb that shows how the meaning of that verb is considered in relation to time, typically expressing if an action is complete, repeated, or continuous

C: › specialized media [ C ] also aspect ratio a measurement of the width compared to the height of the picture on a TV or computer screen
（電視或其他螢幕的）寬高比，縱橫比，長寬比

example: Which aspects of the job do you most enjoy?
你最喜歡這份工作的哪些方面？
His illness affects almost every aspect of his life.
他的疾病幾乎影響到他生活的每個方面。
That's the most worrying aspect of the situation.
這是局勢最令人擔心的一面。
Lighting is a vitally important aspect of filmmaking.
燈光是電影製作中一個至關重要的方面。
Have you thought about the problem from every aspect?
你是不是已經全面地考慮過這個問題？
The dining room has a southern aspect, which allows us to make the most of the sun.
餐室是向南的，這就使我們能夠最有效地利用陽光。
The glasses and the beard lend him a rather scholarly aspect.
他戴著眼鏡，蓄著鬍子，頗有一副學者的樣子。

NONE: › a tree of the poplar family, with leaves that shake even when there is only a little wind
（歐洲）山楊；（北美）大齒楊

example: On our walk along the river we passed thundering waterfalls and quivering aspens.
我們沿著河岸散步，一路經過了雷鳴般的瀑布和搖曳的山楊樹。

NONE: › a type of autism in which someone does not develop normal social abilities and is often very interested in one particular subject
亞斯伯格症候群（孤獨症的一種，缺乏正常的社交能力，通常對某個範疇很有興趣）
› the quality of being severe in the way that you speak and behave
（言語、舉止的）嚴厲，粗暴

example: the asperity of her manner

在…上鋪瀝青

example: an asphalted road/pitch/court
瀝青道路／球場／庭院

NONE: › to cause someone to be unable to breathe, usually resulting in that person's death
使窒息（而死）；使悶死

example: The murder inquiry found that the children had been asphyxiated.

› someone who very much wants to achieve something

NONE: › the sound represented in English by the letter "h", in words such as "house"

I or T: › [ I or T ] US specialized biology to breathe in, or to breathe a substance into your lungs by accident

C usually plural, U: C2 [ C usually plural,  U ] something that you hope to achieve
志向，抱負；渴望達到的目標

U: › [ U ] the noise that is made when air escapes after a plosive consonant sound

example: I've never had any political aspirations.
我從來就沒甚麼政治抱負。

這個故事講述了窮苦的愛爾蘭移民的生活與抱負。

在英語中，送氣與否跟一個詞的起始音是/p/還是/b/有重要關係。

NONE: › showing that you want to have more money and a higher social position than you now have

example: High-end smartphones have become aspirational status symbols, especially among the young.
對那些一心要躋身富貴階層的人而言，特別是在年輕人當中，高端智慧型手機已經成為社會地位的象徵。

NONE: C2 to have a strong wish or hope to do or have something
